values.note: 21 RV sites (R4-R24): water and 30- or 50-amp electric, one (R4, 25 ft back-in) with sewer; posted max RV lengths 24-35 ft, five pull-throughs (R5, R11, R12, R19, R20). 24 tent-only sites (T1-T24), closed to vans, truck campers and trailers. One camping unit per site.

values.note: Coin showers ($0.25 per two minutes); dump station for campers only. No campfires, no charcoal or wood (gas grills allowed), no liquor.

values.note: Reservation required, online only (no in-person or phone payments); a season's bookings open on one February morning (February 11 at 8 am for 2026).
